pages.text: The $(item)Governor$() ($(thing)Control Theory$()) is set against a machine with a console: a multiblock's controller, or a console machine. Once a second, while the machine is short of 75% precision, it moves each setting a fifth of the way toward the recipe's best point; if the machine is not working at all, it sets it there. The machine runs at about 75% precision and stays there, whatever recipe it changes to. It never lowers a machine you have tuned higher.

It never goes all the way: the last quarter, and the extra products it brings, is the console's fine work. A Governor is the way to run many machines well; the console is the way to run one perfectly. On older multiblocks it keeps the tuning dial on its drifting target. It needs 32 FE a tick; right-click it to see what it holds.
